# Native binary operand projection

Two real Witness reds prove cloned and foreign enclosing additions can acquire control authority through a borrowed valid b.N read. Primitive FieldRead authenticated the leaf but not that binary node. BinaryOperands authenticates the selected operation in an explicit native function and validates both input identities and order before returning a fixed pair. It does not copy an expression graph or implement a Go type checker.

Prove native input order and hostile/no-input triad, malformed operation/function/input/cause boundaries, complete68-mode native operator/source-order/prefix matrix, and32/8193 preceding instruction width with fixed native cache allowance <=128 bytes. Mutations must expose skipped instruction/input custody, wrong input order, partial output, lost native cause and retained instruction population. The native compiler's constant branch absence remains neutral.

Witness receives an explicit function in its existing count request and updates all callers directly. Only the binary operand lane is migrated; conversions and Phi/dominance are explicit next work. Reuse unchanged FieldRead leaf proof. Focused race/tools precede serial3s benchmark then3s semantic fuzz. Respect other worker commits/version allocation. No intermediate lint or readiness/independent acceptance claim.
